wizard.lang_devicemode_router_1: I don't have a main router, and I'm going to set up a new wireless network with a modem.
wizard.lang_devicemode_agent_1: I'm adding an Agent device to the existing Smart Mesh Network.
wizard.lang_agentsetup_2: Make sure your main router has Smart Mesh enabled and is connected to the Internet.
wizard.lang_agentsetup_4: Press and hold the WPS buttons on both your main router and agent device for 2-3 seconds. The LED should start blinking.
wizard.lang_agentsetup_7: Connect the main router and the agent device
wizard.lang_agentsetup_8: Plug the Ethernet cable into the LAN port of your router and into the LAN port of your agent device.
wizard.lang_waitsettings_2: It may take 1–2 minutes for the agent to connect to your Wi-Fi mesh network.
wizard.lang_waitsettings_3: Don’t press the WPS button on either device while it’s working.
wizard.lang_finish_2: Wait until the LED stops blinking and turns solid blue.
wizard.lang_finish_3: Then you can log in to the web-based configuration page to check the mesh topology.
wizard.lang_tooltip_wifinetwork_pmf: Protected Management Frames (PMF) secures Wi-Fi by encrypting critical management frames, blocking forged attacks that could disconnect users, and ensuring stable, private connections.
wizard.lang_tooltip_wifinetwork_psc: Preferred Scanning Channel (PSC) is a set of prioritized 6 GHz channels that help Wi-Fi 6E/7 devices connect faster and more reliably by reducing scanning time and avoiding interference.
wizard.lang_tooltip_smartmesh: When Smart Mesh is enabled, your router will be the Mesh Controller. After setup, you can add compatible Mesh Agent devices anytime for whole-home coverage.
wizard.lang_tooltip_wifinetwork_common: When Smart Connect is enabled, all bands (2.4GHz, 5GHz and 6GHz) share one Wi-Fi name and your client devices will join the best band automatically. You can disable Smart Connect if you’d like to set up each band (2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz) separately.
wizard.lang_tooltip_wifinetwork_mlo: Multi-Link Operation (MLO) enables Wi-Fi 7 devices to connect across 2.4, 5, and 6 GHz bands at the same time—delivering faster speeds, lower latency, and greater reliability for VR/AR, gaming, remote work, and cloud computing.
wizard.lang_pppoe_help_msg: Enter your PPPoE username and password. Don’t have them? Contact your ISP for help.
